thread:
rachael: Quick note from onboarding today: docs in samples/voice have drifted. Found bad curl env var and an outdated import.
omar: paste the snippets you saw?
rachael: curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $LEGACY_REDFIELD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/voice/stream \
  -d '{\"text\":\"hi\"}'
```

Also the TS example shows `import { Client } from '@redwood/inference'`.
ben: ok that's two issues: env var renamed to REDWOOD_API_KEY and package is `@redwood-inference/sdk` now.
rachael: there's also a broken relative link to `./examples/voice/async.mjs` -> 404. link-checker flagged it.
link-checker: Broken link found in README -> ./examples/voice/async.mjs (reported 2026-07-12T14:02:11Z)
omar: can you open a tiny PR for the fixes?
rachael: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/6123 title: \"fix(samples): update curl env, correct SDK import, repair example link\". I also changed the code blocks to use language hints (```bash, ```ts) and added a short \"Note on retry defaults\" pointing to /docs/retries.md so we don't accidentally claim SDK parity.
ben: nice. can we also replace any `node-fetch` usage in samples with `undici` and add \"type\":\"module\" so examples run on node20? that would've prevented the ESM confusion.
rachael: added that change and a non-blocking CI job `samples-smoke` that runs `npm ci && node examples/voice/async.mjs`. Put a checklist item in CONTRIBUTING.md: \"verify example env names, imports, and run local smoke test\".
docs-bot: PR opened by rachael: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/6123 :eyes:
ben: small follow-up: create an evergreen issue to grep samples for `@redwood/inference` across the repo in case there are more stale READMEs.
omar: filed issue #1189 and assigned to devex squad.
rachael: merging after green CI. thanks team, this should make onboarding smoother. :white_check_mark:
